name: Sanket Ajmera
bio: Mr. Sanket Ajmera has a mission to change every home in an ideal style, and has served more than 30 clients since founding the firm in 2019. With five fruitful years in the sector, he knows what clients expect and is adept at meeting it.

Ajmera Interiors got its start by building a friend's home in Mumbai, and today the company is firmly established in interior design. Any size or style of project can be configured by Ajmera Interiors. With two hospitality projects completed in Mumbai and a first out-of-town project, a 1,500 sq ft space in Jalgaon, the firm has expanded into commercial work thanks to Mr. Ajmera's vision, and has improved the homes and lives of over 25 families.

Whether you are remodelling your second home or designing your first, Ajmera Interiors is here to help you conceptualise, visualise and accomplish your goals. Mr. Ajmera holds that, regardless of how much money is spent, everyone has the right to customise their home to suit their needs.

name: Ishita Mehta
bio: Ishita Mehta is interested in developing the art of fashionable living, and has been contributing to the company for a while now. Managing an entire company sometimes takes more than one person, and as co-founder Ms. Mehta has contributed to the firm's rapid expansion.

She provides direction for everything from monitoring work completion to collecting extensive client feedback. As co-founder of Ajmera Interiors, Ms. Ishita Mehta stands tall for a vision of providing an affordable yet luxurious place to live.
